evidence.expected: Each archive must match the reviewed runtime, and each hop must remove the lock and report exactly one cleanup-complete terminal summary. The installed legacy CLI and both MCP primaries retain intervention points.
evidence.observed: Independently verified the q5u0 and q5u1 archive SHA-256 digests, outer and inner CRCs, 285 matching embedded members, and 238 shipped scripts/seeds against live per archive. The installed 1.51 CLI and both MCP primaries retained checkpoints, then completed after separate cleanup. Five separately executed focused controls exercised both generated archive forms, an actual extracted cleanup child, eligible stock baseline replacements and preservation of mixed project-owned states.
